purpose: Honest iteration ledger for the S1a self-pair probe (design 024 §7 S1a kill-switch protocol: iterate on mechanics before concluding, report every iteration).

run1.result: GATE FAIL as measured (primary p=0.75, acc real 2/40 zero 1/40 random 2/40)
diagnosis: Accuracy collapse was mechanical, not a channel null: FIRST-PASS (uninjected, plain prompt) accuracy was 5/40 vs the model's expected ~55-65%.

Root cause 1 (numerics): vendored candle-transformers 0.9.2 qwen2 computes RoPE tables after casting position indices to BF16; integers alias above 256, corrupting positions deep into the sequence. Verified live: same prompt clean at F32, degenerate at BF16 ('48 + 24 = 72' -> '7288', duplicated tokens); KV stepwise-vs-prefill argmax parity was 64/64, ruling out the decode loop.
Root cause 2 (compliance): 22/40 run-1 generations never emitted '####'; correct answers in prose were scored wrong, measuring format adherence instead of the latent channel.
fixes_applied_before_run2: RoPE tables computed in F32, only final sin/cos cast to model dtype (src/models/qwen2_a.rs, declared Deviation 4; S0 mechanics gates re-run and all green after the change).
Answer-format instruction rewritten with an anchored example (examples/common/mod.rs ANSWER_FORMAT, rustdoc records the measured run-1 non-compliance).
Scoring: flexible extract ('####'-marked answer, else last number) + numeric equality, applied IDENTICALLY to every condition (real/zero/random) and the first pass.

run2.result: GATE PASS: primary one-sided exact sign test real>random on paired accuracy, 5 wins / 0 losses, p=0.03125 (< alpha 0.05)
run2.statistical_test_unchanged: The primary test, alpha, item set (ChaCha8 0x51A1 over train.jsonl, same 40 indices), decoding, slots, block, pooling and rescale switch are identical to run 1's pre-committed configuration. Only the mechanics fixes above changed.
honest_caveats: p=0.03125 is the minimum attainable with 5 discordant pairs (2^-5); the pass is real but not overwhelming - 40 items is a mechanics probe, not an effect-size estimate.

The NLL secondary diagnostic shows NO effect in run 2 (real vs random 19W/21L, p=0.68; means flat at ~2.13 nats): the run-1 NLL 'effect' (38W/2L real<zero) vanished with the RoPE fix and is best read as an artifact of degraded numerics.

Direction decomposition: real helps (+3 accuracy wins vs zero, 0 losses, p=0.125) AND random hurts (zero 22 vs random 20); the primary contrast passes because injected content matters - aligned state is usable where norm-matched noise is disruptive. That is precisely the 'injection mechanism transmits information' claim of the gate, no more.

evidence_label: live-model, single-host, simulation-free; RTX 5080, nvcc 12.8, deterministic greedy decoding, seeded item selection
